title: Eco Green Support v2.5.9
summary: Excel Bulk Upload Speedup, Date Autofill Fix & Accurate 5-Year Warranty Calculation Engine
features: 🚀 Ultra-Fast Excel Sync: Replaced slow sequential database queries with batched multi-row inserts, eliminating upload abort errors.
📅 Date Autofill Resolution: Fixed date parsing for Excel serial numbers, DD-MM-YYYY, and ISO strings so installation date cleanly auto-fills into date pickers.
🛡️ Accurate 5-Year Warranty Engine: Plants older than 5 years are now strictly classified as Out of Warranty (🔴) across the entire application.
